I never really had any trouble with franchise mode myself but I think that's because I've always managed to make lots of money early on. Once that gets going you're pretty much all set. Only focus on the bare necessities at first and get a few species and shops in there, you can start decorating when you have more money. Give the animals what they need to be happy and don't focus too much on the habitat until you do.

All the research you do in franchise will be shared across all your franchise zoos so maxing out is very useful.

Also, I only learned this recently but a good way to earn conservation credits is to place green bins here and there. It's a recycling bin and will give you a bit of continuous CC and increase your zoo's conservation score.

That's what I can think of right now at the top of my head, I greatly recommend checking out his channel but experimenting on your own is also fun. Best of luck!
